name: Banh sung trau
summary: Bánh sừng trâu is a wrapped cake sold at the Mang Den weekend market, where one visitor joined in wrapping it at the stall.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen, the weekend market, meets on Saturday and Sunday on the pine hill along Hùng Vương. Báo Kon Tum also places it in the pine garden (Vườn thông) by the district central square.
seoTitle: Banh sung trau in Mang Den
seoDescription: Bánh sừng trâu, a wrapped cake sold at the Mang Den weekend market.
